answer: Operator-Linked Resource Deposit: registration maps each wallet to an operator-owned external resource (cloud account, IP block, domain). A flagged identity suspends the operator's whole resource set, not just that wallet. Enforcement triggers when a plume of linked registrations crosses a diversity threshold. Attackers must then wander across separate paid resources per cluster. Cost per identity rises to full resource overhead, measured in quartz-like metered compute.
